name: run-task-end-to-end
description: Guide or carry one implementation task through the selected checkout or worktree workspace, verification, publishing, and branch-preserving cleanup.
dependencies: Claude Code or Codex worktree support
profileAssumptions: Rendered reference files use the current ai_context, ai_continuity, and ai_harness selectors; workflow deletion never changes those selectors.
Runtime isolation is an explicit task option and uses a consuming project's authoritative .worktree-runtime.json when present.

Effective company context requires flow=<digits> for execution tasks that create a branch and uses the flow/<number>-<ascii-description> branch policy; repository instructions may declare an explicit project exception.
The task-workflow and worktree-task-workflow compatibility adapters are part of the canonical migration bundle.
Invocation supports guided no-argument, prompted natural-language, and explicit structured styles; shared semantics stay host-neutral and adapters use native structured questions only when available.

Continuity records retain Task, Branch, Base branch, Base commit, and compatibility Started from metadata; unique parked-state matches are reconciled before restoration, while legacy or ambiguous matches require explicit selection.
